messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Severity=P2 GPU pool saturation in ap-southeast4. Autoscaler failing to provision additional nodes (errors observed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED). Please acknowledge with /ack and follow runbook 'gpu-quota-fallback'. :rotating_light:
oncall-alex: acked. I'm oncall. Looking at autoscaler logs now. Queue length spiking for model-serving-prod, approx +420 reqs/minute.
sre-maya: +1 i'm pulling the allocator logs and quota responses. Sharing initial query results.
infra-raj: seeing repeated API 403s from GCP: "quotaExceeded" for compute.googleapis.com request to create instances in ap-southeast4. No recent quota changes in our org settings AFAIK.
eng-lucy: customers reporting timeouts on /v1/generate for hosted-api-prod region ap-southeast4. Frontend is returning 503s with 'no backend available' for some requests.
support-jordan: Support queue shows 6 customers with elevated alerts: two on production paid plans reporting production impact (latency > 10s and failures). Notifying CSMs.
oncall-alex: quick triage: autoscaler attempted 12 scaleups in last 10m, all failed with quota errors. Pool usage 100% GPUs used, pending queue growth. Fallback policy should route to eu-west1 or us-central1.
infra-raj: checking capacity in eu-west1 and us-central1 now — eu-west1 has spare capacity (~30% free), us-central1 is near 75%.
eng-lucy: can we do runtime routing to eu-west1 for low-latency customers? Need to ensure model variants and quantization profile compatibility. Also KV cache locality will be cold.
sre-maya: propose two immediate mitigations: 1) Route new requests above threshold to eu-west1 via traffic-split policy; 2) For ap-southeast4, drain non-critical batch jobs and reduce concurrent inferences per instance.
oncall-alex: agree. Initiating temporary traffic-split: set route weight ap-southeast4=60%, eu-west1=40% for hosted-api-prod. Command to change routing (console):
```bash
redwoodctl routing set --service hosted-api-prod --policy weighted --weights ap-southeast4=60,eu-west1=40 --comment "temp mitigate quota hit 1745554321"
```
Apply now?
eng-lucy: apply. I'll monitor model correctness and errors.
incident-bot: Deploy job started: routing-change-1745554321 by oncall-alex.
cloud-gcp-bot: Note: there is a pending quota increase request for ap-southeast4 opened 2 weeks ago (REQ-33211) currently in 'pending' state with GCP support. Contacting GCP support recommended.
infra-raj: draining non-critical batch queues: scaling down batch-worker-prod in ap-southeast4 from 8 -> 3, freeing ~6 GPUs. Command:
```yaml
scaler: batch-worker-prod
region: ap-southeast4
replicas: 3
```
Done. Freed 6 GPUs, but autoscaler still hitting quota when attempting to add nodes because soft limit on regional GPUs reached.
sre-maya: posting customer impact summary: "Partial disruption for ap-southeast4 customers: increased latency, intermittent 5xx for some request bursts. Active mitigation: traffic-split to eu-west1 and batch drain. Affected customers: cus-11234, cus-99812 (eng-heavy), cus-5500 (SaaS). ETA to stable: 10-20m depending on routing warmup."
support-jordan: pinging affected customers with status update now. Template: "We are seeing elevated latency in ap-southeast4 due to regional capacity constraints; we are routing traffic to alternate regions and expect improved stability shortly."
oncall-alex: routing change applied. Monitoring metrics: request success rate in ap-southeast4 dropped 7% (expected) but overall success across service improved 12% after split. Queue growth starting to plateau.
eng-lucy: noticing some 504s from cross-region requests due to larger RTTs and cold KV cache misses. We should temporarily relax client-side timeouts for affected customers or flag them.
infra-raj: I've opened an emergency quota support chat with GCP. Case ID: 9876543210. Requesting interim quota bump +50 GPUs in ap-southeast4.
cloud-gcp-bot: GCP Support reply (chat): "We can approve a temporary quota increase for urgent production outages; need justification and expected sustained usage. ETA ~ 2 hours for full approval, may provision quicker if expedited."
sre-maya: action: create runbook item to request expedited escalation. Who owns contacting AM? oncall-alex?
oncall-alex: assigning to infra-raj to escalate with AM.
infra-raj: escalated via AM, added time-series and customer-impact notes. AM acknowledged; attempting phone escalation.
support-jordan: customers ACKed the update and asked for ETA. One customer asked for IP allowlist change for eu-west1 endpoints — we'll coordinate with eng-lucy after stabilization.
eng-lucy: temporary config to increase client timeout: set gateway/read_timeout to 20s for APAC customers via edge config. Pushing change now.
incident-bot: Change applied: edge-timeout-increase-1745554321 by eng-lucy.
sre-maya: monitoring logs for errors: stack traces show model-serving returns OOM on older instance types when cold-started; we should ensure delegating traffic only to instances with required GPU memory. I'll filter target pool by instance-profile=highmem.
oncall-alex: updated routing target to only include highmem instances in eu-west1 to avoid OOMs.
infra-raj: cloud chat updated: GCP can provision a transient quota bump of +20 GPUs within ~30-45m if we accept a short validation period. They need to confirm billing and project details.
sre-maya: that should be enough to allow autoscaler to finish pending scaleups and reduce queue. Keep eu-west1 split until quota bump is in place.
eng-lucy: checkpoint: traffic-split enabled, batch jobs drained, timeouts increased, highmem-only targets for fallback. Observed overall request success improving; some customers still seeing elevated latency.
support-jordan: customers informed; one customer requested a scheduled maintenance window rather than changing endpoints — logged as follow-up.
oncall-alex: status update to #general and SOC: "APAC region ap-southeast4 experiencing GPU quota exhaustion; mitigation in progress (traffic-split to eu-west1, batch drain). No data breach. Oncall and infra pursuing quota increase with GCP. Will update in 30m."
incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-1745554321 created and linked to runbook.
cloud-gcp-bot: GCP update: provisional +20 GPU quota approved for 45 minutes while case is evaluated. Please verify.
infra-raj: confirmed via CLI that quota increased. Autoscaler resumed provisioning and successfully added 4 nodes to ap-southeast4.
eng-lucy: observed warmup — KV cache misses happening but filling. 503s dropping below 1% now.
sre-maya: queue length steadily decreasing, 90th latency back to baseline for most customers.
support-jordan: customer confirmations: cus-11234 reports restoration; cus-99812 still seeing some spike during long requests but much improved.
oncall-alex: next steps: keep traffic-split in place for 1 hour while verifying stability, follow up on permanent quota request REQ-33211, postmortem owner: sre-maya, timeline: runbook review and improved autoscaler error classification.
sre-maya: assigning postmortem: I'll own write-up and recommend: - proactively request higher regional GPU soft-limits in APAC - add autoscaler retry jitter and backoff to avoid repeated quota hits - surface quota exhaustion in dashboards earlier (alert when API returns 429/403 quota errors)
eng-lucy: also recommend a 'regional-fallback' playbook to automatically route to nearest healthy region when autoscaler errors with quota codes.
infra-raj: creating follow-up tickets: TKT-4521 (permanent quota request +AM coordination), TKT-4522 (autoscales error classification), TKT-4523 (runbook update).
oncall-alex: closing the active pager. If anything degrades, re-open thread. Great job team. :tada:
incident-bot: Pager cleared by oncall-alex at 1745556222.
